title: Pool, Hong Kong Island and the Peak
summary: The main Island day and the main night out. Up the Peak early by tram, time at the top through sunset, taxi down.

rows.detail: Optional. This is the best block for sun. Read, tan, swim. Light lunch at the hotel.

rows.what: Graham Street Market, Tai Kwun, PMQ, Mid-Levels escalator
rows.detail: The old street market first, then design and architecture, all within a few blocks.
Standard one-way ticket, prebooked. Sit on the right going up. Then Lugard Road for the best free view, and take your time at the top (How-to 19).
Stay while the city lights come on.
Tram seats face backwards on the way down, so skip it.
The big dinner of the trip. Book ahead.
Taxi back through the tunnel, or a late train to the hotel. The MTR from Central to Tsim Sha Tsui is two stops and runs until after midnight.

rows.what: Or the old tram and the Star Ferry home
rows.detail: Instead of the taxi or train: ride the old tram from Central to Wan Chai, upper deck, about 15 minutes with the neon on. Then take the Star Ferry home from Wan Chai. It adds about half an hour. The last ferry from Wan Chai is 23:00, so leave the bars by about 22:15.

notes: Klook's Peak Tram Fast Track only runs Friday to Sunday. If the Peak moves to Friday 30, that is the ticket to buy.
